New message in #sales:

dave: @lobu who owns the Globex account these days?

input.text:
Hi Dave — I'd love to help with that, but I don't have access to the CRM account data right now to look up who owns the Globex account. 

Can you check the account page directly in the CRM? Or if you know roughly who's been working it, I can help track them down. Let me know if there's another way I can help!

content.text: Responded to Dave. I don't currently have tools to query the CRM's account/owner data, so I let him know I can't look that up directly and pointed him to the account page in the CRM.
